description.Description: Entry group description, which can consist of several sentences or paragraphs that describe entry group contents.

display_name.Description: A short name to identify the entry group, for example, "analytics data - jan 2011".

entry_group_id.Description:
The id of the entry group to create. The id must begin with a letter or underscore,
contain only English letters, numbers and underscores, and be at most 64 characters.

name.Description: The resource name of the entry group in URL format. Example: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entryGroupId}
